{{Top|leg}}
A '''bollen pattern''' was the series of neural connections that linked all of a bodies muscle control to a central location, such as the [[Brain/Legends|brain]] in most [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]. The location and modification of a sentient's bollen pattern was critical to the implantation of a [[Response iMprOVEMENT Package]].
